jobs.description: At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. Job Description Summary: The Senior Manager, Corporate Affairs, will lead the design and execution of strategic communications and corporate engagement initiatives for the BMS based out of Hyderabad, supporting the organization’s reputation, employee engagement, and stakeholder relations. This role is pivotal in shaping the company’s internal and external narrative, ensuring alignment with global standards and local priorities, and fostering a culture of transparency and collaboration across a large, diverse employee base. Support leadership communications by developing clear, timely, and aligned messaging for senior leaders across key internal forums, town halls, employee updates, and organizational announcements. Drive employee engagement initiatives in partnership with business leaders and the culture and engagement team, promoting a sense of purpose and pride among the team. Develop compelling content and campaigns that keep employees informed, motivated, and connected to BMS's mission in science and innovation. Serve as a trusted advisor on internal communications, ensuring consistent messaging and promoting open dialogue within the organization. External Communications & Corporate Engagement: Lead the development and delivery of external communication strategies to enhance BMS Hyderabad’s visibility and reputation among key stakeholders, including government, industry associations, and the broader healthcare community. Position BMS as a leader in science and healthcare innovation through thought leadership opportunities, such as public speaking, media engagement, and participation in industry forums. Shape and manage brand messaging across all external channels, ensuring consistency and alignment with BMS’s global standards. Build and nurture relationships with key external audiences to advocate for BMS’s interests and highlight the organization’s impact and capabilities in advancing healthcare. This role reports directly to the Head of Corporate Affairs, India, and plays a vital part in advancing both internal culture and external visibility to firmly establish BMS Hyderabad as a leader in science and innovation. Qualifications & Skills: 7+ years of experience in corporate affairs, communications, or related roles, preferably within the healthcare, pharmaceutical, or life sciences sector. Demonstrated experience designing and executing communications strategies for organizations with a large and diverse employee base Strong strategic thinking, stakeholder management, and crisis communications skills. Experience working with senior executives and collaborating with cross-functional teams in a matrix environment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in additional Indian languages is an advantage. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in communications, Public Relations, Business Administration, or related field. Preferred Attributes: Understanding of the healthcare/pharma landscape in India. Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Commitment to ethical standards and organizational values. Experience with digital communications, social media, and data-driven campaign management. About Bristol Myers Squibb Bristol Myers Squibb R&D is a science-driven, enthusiastic organization determined to discover, develop and deliver medicines that have the potential to transform the lives of patients and establish new standards of care in areas of high unmet need. Patients’ needs and scientific discovery are our driving force. We have a history of scientific excellence. We dramatically changed outcomes in HIV; we helped discover a cure for HCV; and we developed a novel medicine with proven benefit for atrial fibrillation. We also pioneered targeting the immune system in cancer research, breaking new ground in the science of immuno-oncology. Today, we are transforming the way certain cancers are treated and focusing our research efforts on areas of high unmet need in Oncology, Hematology, Cardiovascular disease, Immunology and Fibrosis. Our goal is to leave an enduring positive impact on society by making a meaningful difference in the lives of even more patients. Our people are our greatest asset. Our R&D organization is made up of industry-leading researchers and drug developers who have a passion for science, a curiosity for discovery and a commitment to translating these advances into medicines that make a difference for patients. Our teams are part of a unique global ecosystem that is set up to be agile, interactive, and conducive to translating a nascent idea into a powerful treatment. We follow the science. Our pipeline of promising molecules and medicines is deliberately built through a multi-disciplinary, collaborative approach. We are deepening our understanding of disease biology and uncovering biomarker insights to help predict how patients will respond to treatment with the goal of making precision medicine a reality for more patients. We believe partnership and collaboration are essential. Academic research centers, laboratories, clinicians, clinical trials organizations, government, advocates, and industry – all these organizations contribute to a vibrant healthcare ecosystem that is critical to continued scientific advancement. From the global research networks, we’ve created to our creative approach to business development, we complement internal innovation with external innovation – identifying new scientific hypotheses to better understand how to translate research findings into improved patient outcomes. We believe digital health and data connectivity is transforming our industry. Over the past few years, there has been an explosion of available electronic medical records, genomics and claims data. This, combined with our own data, biomedical and health informatics partnerships, and new analytical tools, is changing how we interact with payers, suppliers, and patients. By leveraging the collective power of data & analytics, we are accelerating the pipeline, enhancing the speed of clinical trials, demonstrating the value of our medicines and helping to inform clinical decisions. We are constantly anticipating what is coming next, navigating and discovering new technologies, enabling our understanding of new ways to use them and applying them to advance drug discovery, development and delivery to patients as quickly as possible. Our mission is clear: to discover, develop and deliver innovative medicines to patients with serious diseases. We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
As an Enterprise Account Executive, System Integrators based in Tokyo, you'll be the critical link between Anthropic and Japan's leading system integrator ecosystem. You'll build and deepen strategic partnerships with major SIers — enabling them to confidently sell, implement, and support Anthropic's AI solutions within their own client portfolios. This is a high-impact, relationship-driven role that directly shapes how frontier AI reaches Japan's largest enterprises.
Key responsibilities
Own and grow revenue generated through SIer channels by developing joint go-to-market strategies, co-selling motions, and enablement programs with Japan's top system integrators
Build and execute partner territory plans, identifying and prioritizing relationships across tier-1 and regional SIers — including firms across IT consulting, systems integration, and managed services practices
Lead strategic engagement with senior SIer leadership — including practice heads, solution architects, pre-sales directors, and partner managers — building the technical confidence and commercial alignment needed to close enterprise deals
Orchestrate internal teams (Product, Engineering, Applied AI, Partnerships, Marketing) to deliver enablement resources, joint solution frameworks, and go-to-market collateral that equips SIer partners to position and deploy Anthropic's AI solutions effectively
Act as the primary escalation and support point for SIer partners navigating complex enterprise opportunities, ensuring deal momentum and customer satisfaction across the full sales cycle
Preferred qualifications
8+ years of enterprise sales or partner management experience in Japan, with significant direct experience working with or selling through system integrators in the technology sector
A deep understanding of how Japan's SIer ecosystem operates — including how SIers source, evaluate, and commit to vendor partnerships, and how they structure solutions for their enterprise clients
A track record of building high-trust, mutually beneficial relationships with SIer organizations, driving consistent revenue through channel partnerships rather than direct sales alone
Demonstrated ability to navigate complex, multi-layered SIer stakeholder environments — balancing the needs of the SIer's internal leadership, their end customers, and Anthropic's own business objectives
Proven experience developing and executing partner enablement programs — including technical training, sales toolkits, and co-marketing initiatives — that meaningfully increase a partner's ability to sell and deliver
A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality — you are a true team player who thrives in ambiguous, startup-like environments
A strategic, analytical approach to evaluating and prioritizing SIer partnerships combined with patient, relationship-focused execution
A passion for and/or experience with advanced AI systems. You feel strongly about ensuring frontier AI systems are developed safely and responsibly for broad benefit
Excellent communication skills in both Japanese and English
What We Offer
Competitive base salary and commission structure commensurate with experience
Equity participation
Comprehensive benefits package
Hybrid work model with flexibility
Access to cutting-edge AI technology and world-class research team
Logistics
Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit
anthropic.com/careers
directly for confirmed position openings.
How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
Come work with us!
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.

jobs.description: We are the Global Procurement Organization, and we're on a mission to reshape how one of the world's largest companies powers its operations with clean energy. We're looking for a Category manager to own and scale our on site solar energy portfolio across Europe, the UK, and the Middle East, driving hundreds of megawatts of new capacity and tens of millions in cost savings. You'll be building the playbook for solar procurement in some of the fastest growing renewable energy markets on the planet. Own the full solar portfolio across a diverse set of markets from Western Europe to the Arabian Peninsula, where solar capacity is projected to grow 10x by 2035 Navigate complex regulatory landscapes from EU clean energy mandates to Saudi Vision 2030 and UAE's ambitious renewable targets Structure creative deals deciding when to deploy capital purchases vs. power purchase agreements vs. operating lease models across markets with very different economics Drive real sustainability impact your work will directly eliminate thousands of metric tons of CO2 annually while reducing grid dependency across hundreds of logistics facilities. Shape a category from the ground up in emerging Middle East markets, where solar is unlocking operations in locations where traditional grid connections aren't even possible If you love solving complex problems across cultures and borders, and want your work to have measurable environmental and financial impact, this is the role. Key job responsibilities - Develop and execute the long term sourcing strategy for on site solar across Europe, UK, and Middle East covering rooftop, carport, and ground mount technologies - Lead portfolio based tenders, bundling demand across multiple countries to maximize negotiation leverage and reduce procurement cycle times - Build financial models including net present value, total cost of ownership, and payback analysis to support investment decisions and senior leadership recommendations - Own strategic supplier relationships through quarterly business reviews, performance tracking, and capacity planning while maintaining competitive tension across the vendor base - Identify and mitigate supply chain risks including equipment lead times, trade policy shifts, and regional market constraints - Track energy production performance against forecasts and drive continuous improvement in system output and cost efficiency - Lead category consolidation efforts, bringing fragmented solar activities under a unified procurement framework to unlock savings and standardize specifications A day in the life Your day starts with a portfolio review call across European markets, then shifts to negotiating contract terms with a supplier for a compliance driven deployment. After lunch, you're deep in a financial model stress testing deal structures for a new Middle East opportunity. By afternoon, you're syncing with engineering, legal, finance, sustainability, and construction partners to keep projects on track. The variety is constant and no two days look the same as you move between strategy, negotiation, and execution across time zones. We manage the full energy lifecycle for Amazon's worldwide operations across five areas: utilities supply and audits, power infrastructure and grid services, on site renewables and storage, EV charging infrastructure, and hydrogen mobility solutions. This role sits within the renewables and storage pillar, but you'll work alongside colleagues tackling everything from microgrids and demand response to hydrogen refueling and electric vehicle charging. We're a global team that is scaling fast and rewriting how large scale operations source, generate, and consume power.
